subject: [PATCH 38/60] mm/page_alloc: refuse contiguous allocation from private memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series aims to prevent contiguous allocations from private memory nodes, which can bypass zonelists and trigger compaction and reclaim. It does this by adding a check for private memory nodes in the alloc_contig_frozen_range_noprof function.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series modifies the Linux kernel's page allocation mechanism to prevent contiguous allocations from private memory nodes, which can bypass zonelists and trigger compaction and reclaim.
